title: The Classroom of 2033
script: It is 2033. One classroom. Twenty-eight AI tutors. One student learns fractions with a pizza. Another gets a football diagram. A third needs the problem read aloud. The teacher stops repeating the explanation and starts noticing who has gone quiet. A tutor recommends the easier course. The student asks whether that means they are not good enough. The teacher closes the suggestion. Some decisions need more than a prediction. If every child gets an AI tutor, what should it never decide for them?
